conviction_note: Arrowhead reports its fiscal year-end (Q4 FY2026) after a 15.4% sympathy drop on 2026-11-09, when Ionis halved its Tryngolza guide on a slow launch in severe hypertriglyceridemia (sHTG), and 18% down over 5 sessions. The print is Arrowhead's first chance to put its own REDEMPLO numbers and its sHTG plans against that read-through. Arrowhead's own management had told the market on 2026-08-04 to expect a slow, education-driven sHTG ramp, and the 2026-11-04 refinancing removed a 15% loan with sweeps. So I lean mildly up (p_up 55) on a washed-out tape, with abs_move 7.5, above the 5.86% event-implied move because this is a year-end print in a vol spike (ATM IV 77.9). The +0.75 scaled number sits below the +1.3 sum of the findings, because the revenue bar has one source and REDEMPLO revenue is still tiny against a ~$7bn market cap.
bar: Fiscal Q4 FY2026 consensus revenue $66.3M and EPS -$1.59, from one source (finviz/Zacks-style preview, https://finviz.com/news/416177/arrowhead-must-show-redemplo-traction-and-shtg-filing-progress-after-32-slide, 2026-11-04). A second agreeing estimate source was not found, so every finding that depends on the bar is capped small. The company gives no revenue guidance (https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/arrowhead-pharmaceuticals-reports-fiscal-2026-third-quarter-results). The stock trades on REDEMPLO scripts and sHTG filing/launch commentary, not on collaboration revenue.
positioning_check: Short interest 10,760,000 shares, days to cover 5.7, as of 2026-10-25 (https://shortsqueeze.com/?symbol=ARWR). That is roughly 7-8% of float on ~143M shares (market cap ~$7bn at $49.21 per https://www.ibtimes.com.au/arrowhead-shares-fall-ionis-tryngolza-forecast-1878219). Earlier readings: ~9.1% of float (Benzinga, undated) and 9.2M shares / 7.8 DTC at the 2026-08-14 settlement (curvedtrading). Not a crowded short, but meaningful. The baseline's skew_25d is null (no usable skew), put/call OI 0.57 leans to calls, and the event-implied move is 5.86% (straddle 9.82%). Tape: -18.0% over 5 days, -19.5% over 20 days, -47.4% from the 52-week high, +23.7% off the low.

findings.finding: On 2026-11-09 Ionis cut its 2026 Tryngolza guide to ~$50M from $100-110M, citing a slower sHTG launch: Q3 US sales were $9M, after FDA approval for sHTG on 2026-06-24. The same day ARWR fell 15.4% to $49.21 on about 2x average volume with no ARWR news. But Arrowhead's own management had already told investors on its 2026-08-04 call to expect a slow, education-driven sHTG ramp. And Arrowhead is not yet launched in sHTG: its sNDA is due by year-end 2026. The print is the first chance for management to restate its own sHTG expectations against the competitor's miss. The market is holding a sharply lowered sHTG launch curve for plozasiran; a reaffirmed filing timeline and launch plan would argue the sympathy drop overshot.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Median absolute print reaction 5.17% over 7 prints. Largest was +23.3% on 2025-11-25, the year-end print that carried the REDEMPLO approval and a $200M Sarepta milestone. The last three prints were -3.0%, -6.75% and -0.2%, so recent prints have been sold or flat.
findings.why_not_priced: The Ionis cut is fully in the price; that is what the -15% was. What is not priced is Arrowhead's own response. If the market already gave ARWR credit for its August slow-ramp guidance, the stock would not have fallen 15% on a competitor's miss that was in line with what ARWR had said, with no ARWR-specific news (goldesel 2026-11-09 found no company trigger). The risk cuts both ways: if management lowers its own sHTG ambitions, the drop extends.
findings.independence: Management's August slow-ramp framing: https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/arrowhead-pharmaceuticals-q3-earnings-call-highlights-2026-08-04/ (via a search summary; the page returned 403). Ionis cut details: https://www.panabee.com/news/ionis-pharmaceuticals-earnings-q3-2026. Tryngolza sHTG approval date: https://hcplive.com/view/fda-approves-olezarsen-tryngolza-severe-hypertriglyceridemia. The three sources are independent of each other.

findings.finding: Fiscal Q3 REDEMPLO (FCS) net product revenue was ~$2.4M, more than double the ~$1M of the prior quarter. Prescription volume roughly doubled in the quarter, from ~30 new scripts a week, with >400 unique prescribers, and management said momentum continued into fiscal Q4. Fiscal Q4 also adds the EU, Australian and UK (MHRA 2026-10-27, after quarter end) approvals. Another doubling (~$4-5M) is the bar the street is looking for; it is the only company-level launch metric the market gets before sHTG.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: REDEMPLO metrics were first disclosed at the 2026-02-05 print (-0.19%) and the 2026-05-07 print (-6.75%). Scripts doubled at the 2026-08-04 print and the stock still fell -2.99%, so this line has not been paid.
findings.why_not_priced: No independent script data (IQVIA) for Sep-Nov 2026 was found publicly, so the market prices the launch off Ionis's weak competitor number. If ARWR's FCS trajectory were already priced as intact, the stock would not have absorbed the full Ionis read-through. Net of the rest of the company: product revenue is under 10% of revenue and immaterial to a ~$7bn value, so the move is on the trajectory as a signal for sHTG, not on the dollars. Sized small because this line has been sold on the last three prints.
findings.independence: The Q3 release confirms scripts roughly doubling and >400 prescribers: https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/arrowhead-pharmaceuticals-reports-fiscal-2026-third-quarter-results. That is the same company disclosure, so not independent on the Q4 number.

findings.finding: On 2026-11-04 Arrowhead refinanced its $400M Sixth Street loan. The old loan carried 15% interest, a 2x-2.5x MOIC and mandatory sweeps of upfront, milestone and royalty receipts. It was retired at a $68M discount to the contractual minimum repayment. The new $400M term loan bears SOFR+5.50%, matures 2031-11-02, has no amortization and no sweeps. Cash and investments were $1.567bn at 2026-06-30. The money buys lower carry and keeps future partner milestones uncommitted; there is no distress read.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior print with a financing change. The stock fell after the announcement, from ~$59.5 on 2026-11-04 to $49 by 2026-11-09, but that slide was driven by the Ionis read-through.
findings.why_not_priced: The refinancing is public, but the call will quantify the interest saving and any extinguishment gain, and will show the lower cash burn in FY2027 commentary. If the market had credited it, the stock would not have kept sliding into the print. Sized small because the release is in the public record.
findings.independence: Original facility terms (15%, MOIC, sweeps): https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20240808218819/en/Arrowhead-Pharmaceuticals-Announces-500-Million-Strategic-Financing-Facility-with-Sixth-Street. Cash: https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/arrowhead-pharmaceuticals-reports-fiscal-2026-third-quarter-results

findings.finding: Fiscal Q3 revenue of $75.3M was ~$26M Sarepta collaboration, ~$20M Novartis collaboration, a $25M one-off Madrigal upfront (ARO-PNPLA3) and ~$2.4M REDEMPLO. No new license or upfront was found for July-September 2026. The recurring run-rate ex-Madrigal is ~$50-55M, below the $66.3M consensus for fiscal Q4, so a revenue miss against the one-source bar is plausible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Collaboration revenue is lumpy and has rarely driven the reaction. Fiscal Q3 beat revenue ($75.3M vs ~$57M) and missed EPS, and the stock fell -2.99%.
findings.why_not_priced: The consensus carries $66.3M, which would be visibly lower if estimates had stripped out the Madrigal one-off and assumed no new deal. Capped small: the bar has one source, collaboration revenue is recognised on a cost-to-complete basis that can swing, and this line does not move the stock.
findings.independence: Revenue mix figures come from call summaries (gurufocus transcript https://www.gurufocus.com/stock/LTS:0HI3/transcripts/9004193). The Madrigal $25M upfront is confirmed separately: https://www.nasdaq.com/press-release/arrowhead-pharmaceuticals-licenses-clinical-mash-program-targeting-pnpla3-madrigal

findings.finding: On its Q3 2026 report (early November) Sarepta, under new CEO Severino, pushed full 12-week multiple-ascending-dose data for SRP-1003 (ex-ARO-DM1, Arrowhead-partnered) to Q1 2027 from before end-2026. Q4 2026 brings only partial MAD data. This delays visibility on later development milestones owed to Arrowhead. Sarepta also sold ARWR shares in May 2026.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Partner milestones moved the stock on the 2025-11-25 year-end print (+23.3%, which included the $200M Sarepta milestone). The delay has no print history.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a partner's disclosure that ARWR coverage may not carry into near-term milestone expectations. Small, because no milestone was expected in this window and the call may simply restate Sarepta's timeline.
findings.independence: Sarepta Q3 summary: https://www.panabee.com/news/sarepta-therapeutics-earnings-q3-2026 (secondary). May share sale: https://weissratings.com/en/instant-news-alerts/arrowhead-pharmaceuticals-inc-arwr-down-6-3-should-i-bank-what-i-have-left

findings.finding: On 2026-10-07 the FDA admitted the planned plozasiran sHTG sNDA to its STAR pilot. That qualifies the filing for 6-month priority review, with action possibly one month early, without using a voucher. So Arrowhead retains the priority review voucher it bought for $215M in August 2026, a sellable asset. Management reaffirmed sNDA submission by end-2026. The call can confirm submission timing and say what it will do with the voucher.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Regulatory-timeline items have not been print drivers on their own. The sHTG Phase 3 data and the filing plan were public before the -2.99% fiscal Q3 reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: The STAR entry is public. A voucher sale or monetisation plan is not announced. If the market valued a ~$150-215M spare voucher plus a mid-2027 sHTG launch, the stock would not sit 47% off its high. Small, because the voucher is ~2-3% of market cap and any sale is unannounced.

findings.finding: Positioning into the print is washed out. The stock is -18.0% over 5 sessions and -47.4% from the 52-week high. It fell from $80.67 on 2026-09-14 to $47.12, via a -9% day on ARO-DIMER-PA data on 2026-09-15 and the -15.4% Ionis sympathy day. Short interest is 10.76M shares (~7-8% of float) at 5.7 days to cover (2026-10-25), and put/call OI is 0.57.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last three prints were sold (-3.0, -6.75, -0.2) while the stock was trading nearer its highs. This print comes off a 52-week-high drawdown of 47%.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is the price itself, so this is a mechanism and not hidden information. With expectations reset by a competitor's miss, a neutral print has room to relieve. Sized small.
findings.independence: Earlier slide: https://www.rttnews.com/3691229/arrowhead-pharmaceuticals-stock-falls-9-after-announcement-of-aro-dimer-pa-trial-data.aspx; and the Ionis day: https://www.ibtimes.com.au/arrowhead-shares-fall-ionis-tryngolza-forecast-1878219

findings.finding: At AHA on 2026-11-08 Arrowhead presented pooled SHASTA-3/4 data: acute pancreatitis events -78% vs placebo, and -91% in sHTG patients with recent pancreatitis. It also presented PALISADE open-label data with triglyceride and APOC3 reductions durable to 36 months, and ARO-DIMER-PA single-dose LDL-C reductions of up to 65%. The stock fell 18.8% in EUR terms the next day, on the Ionis news rather than the data.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Data days have been sold: -9% on the 2026-09-15 DIMER-PA topline, and down on the 2026-11-09 AHA follow-up day.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: the data were public four days before the print. Filed at 0 for completeness. The pancreatitis benefit is the differentiation argument management will lean on against Tryngolza.

outside_window.finding: Plozasiran sHTG sNDA submission (by end-2026) and a STAR/priority review, pointing to a ~mid-2027 FDA action and Q2 2027 launch.
Sarepta full 12-week SRP-1003 (DM1) MAD data, now Q1 2027, which drives future Arrowhead milestones.

baseline_tension: The mild positive lean cuts against the strong -18% 5-day and -19.5% 20-day momentum and a 47% drawdown. The baseline gives no skew; put/call OI of 0.57 leans to calls. That is why p_up stays at 55 rather than higher: the market has just repriced the sHTG thesis on a direct competitor's number, and Arrowhead cannot disprove that on an FCS-only quarter.
lessons_applied: Rule 5 (positioning and borrow are the information set, not a finding): positioning finding cut from +0.5 to +0.3 rather than dropped, because the drawdown has a sourced cause (Ionis), not an unexplained one.
Rule 6 (bar from one source): revenue-bar finding confirmed capped at -0.3; noted in bar that only one estimate source was found.
Rule 1 (verified fact is not a reaction; REDEMPLO doubling was sold -3% last print): REDEMPLO finding kept at +0.5, already sized for this; p_up held at 55.
Rule 4 (financing is a question): refinancing signed positive after checking what it buys (lower carry, no sweeps, $1.57bn cash); unchanged at +0.3.
